notes.title: "Double Trouble Pack" Now Available!
notes.content:
We've launched the "Double Trouble Pack," a Steam sale that includes both "Slay the Dragon! The Fire-Breathing Tyrant Meets Her Match!" as well as "Dark Waters: Gino and the Witch of the Black Swamp." Buy them collectively and you'll get them at a nice 20% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40771/DoubleTrouble_Pack/

There's no particular reason to scoop them up at the same time, though you may find that each title poses and answers some questions about the other...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/a6fab157a2e7b275b2d6a9d78be912aa84565c32.png[/img]

If you enjoyed "Dark Waters," we're confident you'll love our new monster girl eroge with a similar (but less brutal) dark twist.

notes.title: Outis Media's "Slay the Dragon!" Comes to Steam
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2558520


[i][b]"Slay the Dragon! The FIre-Breathing Tyrant Meets Her Match!" is coming to Steam.[/b][/i]

The game takes place in a nondescript location, starring a lifeguard who had to start life over after sustaining a crippling injury. Time passes by uneventfully, as you dawdle with your duties in the company of your childhood friend, just living life one day at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/7f6448266810a4628f461b4da132e160a5ca6ae1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/841dcdb3023d83db5cbe49426cda95901b656c16.png[/img]

However, your life is turned upside down (again) when a miserable tyrant named Freya Knox sets her sights on you, hell-bent on destroying everything you've built. Your choices in the game will dictate your fate, whether or not you survive Freya's torment and one-up her, or became her slave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/feb9b11ac681a5a573aacd6dcae0ca6fc38f4752.png[/img]

The title lies in the same vein as "Dark Waters," but showcases more choices and has multiple endings to uncover.

Please consider wish-listing the title, today, if you like what you see~

notes.title: "Dark Waters: Gino and the Witch of the Black Swamp" Out Now!
notes.content:
[i][b]"Dark Waters: Gino and the Witch of the Black Swamp" is now available on Steam! [/b][/i]

Outis Media released "The Dandelion Girl" a number of years ago, and this is our first return to form with a NVL-style VN. We're still experiencing some hiccups getting used to the Steam format and everything that comes with it, so we appreciate your patience.

Players can expect a carefully knit story in "Dark Waters" that will make the hair stand up on your neck without relying on cheap jump scares, with sexy comfy H-scenes interspersed in which not everything is as it seems. 

Players regularly told us that the ending to "The Dandelion Girl" pulled the rug out from under them, and you may find a surprise or two in "Dark Waters" as well. Obviously, "Dark Waters" is very NSFW in nature and only for adults. Enjoy the brief time you spend with the witch of the black swamp, Cuca Rivers, if you dare.

If you enjoy our new game, please consider leaving a review! Every little bit helps us make more content like this.

Thanks again!
